axis: a slight noticeable lean → a bias that shuts out fair judgement

members.tone: The plain name for an uneven leaning toward one side over the alternatives — it says the scales are tipped without saying the case is already closed, which is what *prejudice* adds.
The heaviest word here, because the leaning has hardened into an obstruction: the issue can no longer get an objective hearing at all.
Understates by design — a lean small enough to be measured rather than denounced, yet the word still insists it can be seen.
Names the leaning by what it fastens on, one particular place, so the narrowness of the horizon is carried in the word rather than argued separately as it would be with *partiality*.
